title: The Fox and the Key
scenes: Winter morning in a quiet forest. A young red fox digs in fresh snow and uncovers a small brass key.
The fox carries the key in its mouth to a hollow tree where an old grey owl lives, and drops it at the owl's feet.
The owl turns the key over with one talon, then points a wing deep into the forest.
The fox and the owl travel together through tall pines, the owl gliding just above the fox.
At the roots of a giant oak they find a tiny round wooden door, no taller than the fox.
The fox turns the key in the lock while the owl watches from a low branch. Warm light spills out of the opening door.
